name: Ink Wash
description: Ink blooming in clear water: each press releases a bloom that billows, folds on itself and thins as a slow current swirls it away.

props.name: colors
props.description: Up to three inks, used in turn for each bloom. Without it, deep ink by day and pale water-blue light at night. Any CSS colours or tokens.

props.name: spread
props.description: How far a bloom pushes out before the current takes over. 2 is about twice as wide.

props.name: fade
props.description: Seconds until a bloom has thinned away.

props.name: auto
props.description: Open two blooms on their own when the component first comes into view.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and clips the ink. Other div props are passed through.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the water. Presses on links, buttons and fields stay with them; a press anywhere else releases ink, and dragging lets a little more out along the way.
